title: Snowy mountain road
subject: Subject: an old paved mountain road under light snow, about 2.5 m across. Rounded, roughly rectangular grey paving blocks in rows, snow packed into every joint and lying in small soft patches over some blocks, spread evenly. Cold blue moonlit colours.
use: The road through the frozen pass.

title: Deep snow
subject: Subject: deep, soft, undisturbed snow, about 3 m across. Gentle low drifts and hollows in pale blue-white with soft lilac-blue shading, a faint sparkle, nothing poking through. Moonlit night colours.
use: The snow-covered ground of the north: the frozen pass, Misthollow's terraces and anywhere deep in snow.

title: Cracked river ice
subject: Subject: a frozen river seen from above, about 3 m across. Flat plates of ice in deep blue and paler blue, separated by thin, branching white cracks and seams, a few small air bubbles and frosty patches inside the ice. No snow drifts, no rocks. Cold moonlit colours.
use: The frozen river of the pass, the crossroads' frozen pond, and other frozen water in the north.

title: Snowy rock cliff
subject: Subject: the face of a dark grey rock cliff in winter, about 4 m across. Rough vertical columns and blocks of rock with cracks between them, and soft caps of snow on the ledges, spread evenly over the face. Moonlit blue night colours.
use: The rock outcrops and cliffs of the north: the pass, the crossroads' corners, the shipyard's rock and Misthollow's cliffs.

title: Frozen waterfall
subject: Subject: a frozen waterfall, seen flat from the front, about 10 m tall: the falls caught in ice in two steps over dark rock, thick pale-blue ice columns and long icicles hanging from each lip, snow heaped on the rocks either side, and a frozen pool at its foot. The whole waterfall is in the picture.
use: The waterfall in the frozen pass's north-east corner.

title: Snowy crossing pillar
subject: Subject: a tall square pillar of grey cut stone blocks, seen flat from the front, about 4 m tall, with a stepped base and a squared cap, thick snow on the cap and on each ledge, frost in the joints. The whole pillar is in the picture.
use: The four pillars at the ends of the frozen pass's river crossing.

title: Snow-laden pine
subject: Subject: one spruce-like pine, about 10 m tall, seen from the side, whole, with its trunk foot at the bottom. Dark blue-green drooping branches in tiers, every tier heavy with thick soft snow, a narrow pointed top. Moonlit night colours.
use: The pines of the frozen pass and Misthollow, and any snowy forest in the north.

title: Snowy bare bush
subject: Subject: one leafless bush, about 1.5 m tall, seen from the side, whole, with its base at the bottom. Thin dark brown branches and twigs, each with a line of snow on top, a little snow mound at its foot. Night colours.
use: Scattered in the snow of the frozen pass.

title: Icicle fringe
subject: Subject: a fringe of icicles hanging from a short ledge of snow-capped rock, seen from the front, about 1.5 m wide: pale blue, glassy icicles of mixed lengths, the longest about 1 m, hanging down. The ledge is at the top of the picture.
use: Hung under rock ledges in the frozen pass and by the waterfall.
